look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Follow a slender flowering stem. Narrow, smooth-edged leaves can be opposite lower down but become alternate higher up. Look for spaced rose-purple flowers in the leaf axils, each with six petals and a slender ribbed floral tube; compare the flower from the side as well as face-on. Do not identify solely by petal color.
